entries.title: Ask HN: Which book can attract anyone towards your field of study?
entries.author: debanjan16
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Which book can attract anyone towards your field of study?
entries.excerpt: If you were to choose one book (or maybe more than one :P) to lure a curious person to your field of study, which will you choose? For example: How to Design Programs for Computer Science. Note: It has to be inviting for someone that knows nothing about the field but becomes hooked after reading it. Not some epitome which is revered by experts only.

entries.title: Ask HN: What bits of fundamental knowledge are productivity multipliers?

entries.guide_zh: 哪些基础知识一旦掌握，就能在很多工作中成倍提高效率？
